Senpai bows deeply.

message: 「Sister...」
Hearing those words, loneliness and insecurity rushed in all at once.
Everyone fell silent, staring at Senpai with vulnerable eyes.

name: Ria
message: 「Though, after finally becoming such good friends with everyone... parting ways like this feels a bit lonely.」
Ah, that's right.
This means it's goodbye to Senpai.
Even though I knew this day would come eventually, coming so abruptly like this has left me bewildered.
Everyone must be reminiscing in their own way about those days spent with Senpai, brief as they were.
About those fun-filled days.
If only Senpai could stay, these days would surely be so much more fun--

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't want that!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't want us to say goodbye! Ending things like this is too cruel! I absolutely won't accept it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai-san... Senpai-san...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Back when my term as secretary hadn't even started yet, while we were working on handing over duties...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My shoulders are so stiff...」

name: Ria
message: 「How about some dango?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*pant* *pant*... It's so heavy...」

name: Ria
message: 「Would you like a dorayaki?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai-saaand. There's something I don't quite understand...」

name: Ria
message: 「Would you like some yokan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*sigh* Being a secretary sure is tough...」

name: Ria
message: 「How about some karintou?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, but you have to eat outside, okay?\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai has helped me so much up until now.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Along the way, she taught me what it truly means to be a secretary--and how to enjoy Student Council activities.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan was only recommended because she has nice handwriting, after all~」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, aren't you just eating sweets the whole time? I'm jealous...」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It kind of feels like bribing her with food...\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai was also the one who taught me that there's more to it than just writing down words.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wonder what else she taught you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please keep teaching me so, so, so much more fun stuff from now on, Senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-san...」

name: Misa
message: 「M-May I say something too?!」

name: Misa
message: 「It was when I first met Senpai... I still remember it vividly.」

name: Ria
message: 「...Hey, do you mind if I interrupt for a second?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes?」

name: Ria
message: 「Excuse me for just a moment.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yep. There we go.」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai fixed my crooked tie. There aren't many people who would pay attention to a run-of-the-mill first-year like me.」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai softly and gently touched my neck and tied my tie for me. Her slender, supple fingertips were like they were dancing... Ah, so dreamy...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What does that have to do with anything?」

name: Misa
message: 「That was just the prologue!!」

name: Misa
message: 「On one sunny morning on the way to school--」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaah!?」

name: Misa
message: 「For some reason, a banana peel was left right on the side of the road, as if lying in wait!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Again...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Losing my balance, I was just about to fall forward. But--」

name: Ria
message: 「Giggle, are you okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「Catching me in a soft, gentle embrace was unmistakably Senpai's body...」

name: Misa
message: 「A tender and warm embrace... Senpai held me tight. And then she softly whispered into my ear--」

name: Ria
message: 「You are... 'Misa', right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh, Senpai. How do you know my name...!」

name: Ria
message: 「Is it wrong for me... to be interested in you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Giggle, blushing like that is so cute. You're just like a little sister.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, if I could become your soeur... then I...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is this non-fiction?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ugh, umm. Was it... like that...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course, that wasn't all--」

name: Synn
message: 「There's more!?」

name: Misa
message: 「It was when a vicious dog confronted me on my way home.」

name: Misa
message: 「Terrified, my legs froze and I couldn't move. Just then--」

name: Ria
message: 「Stand down!」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Senpai!?」

name: Ria
message: 「If you dare hurt my Misa, I will never forgive you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, sister...」

name: Ria
message: 「You're safe now. Are you hurt?」

name: Misa
message: 「A-Ah, thank you so much!」

name: Ria
message: 「If anything were to happen to you, Misa... Just the thought of it terrifies me...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ngh, sob...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sister! I'm completely fine. So please, wipe away your tears.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ugh... Misa, my sweet Misa... I can't bear the thought of you getting hurt... sob...」

name: Misa
message: 「Back then, you were so brave, Senpai! Absolutely wonderful! And yet, having that vulnerable side to you as well was just marvelous...」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's what happened, huh...?」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Huh? Pretty sure that was a cute little puppy, wasn't it? And that's pretty far off from how I remember it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is this a story about the vice president messing up?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, how much trouble did you even cause her back then?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not what I mean! What I want to say is, um, well...」

name: Misa
message: 「You were my role model, Senpai. When you were chosen as Student Council President, I was so happy--」

name: Misa
message: 「It was after that. I wanted to follow in your footsteps, so I decided to join the Student Council and do my best, too.」

name: Misa
message: 「I was chosen as an officer, and I finally got to connect with you. We finally got so close, and yet...」

name: Misa
message: 「I want to spend even more time with you, Senpai!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I agree! Having Senpai around puts us at ease, makes us feel safe, and helps out a ton.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, the Student Council is way more fun with more members. That's all!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone...」

name: Helena
message: 「President, Vice President, Treasurer, Secretary. Which means there's no particular position left for Ria.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please don't be so mean, Madam Chairwoman.」

name: Helena
message: 「Am I wrong, though? If you don't have a role, you can't stay here.」
A place for Ria―senpai...? Wait, did Helena just give us a huge hint―?

name: Synn
message: 「That's it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why don't we just create a new position for her?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Respecting student autonomy is our school's creed.」

name: Helena
message: 「Even so, this year's Student Council President says some pretty interesting things~」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that a no...?」

name: Helena
message: 「The rules of the Student Council are \{decided by the Student Council itself|\s12\s12\s12\s12\s12\s12\s12\s12\s12}, so there's nothing I can do about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Decided by us...」

name: Misa
message: 「Doesn't that mean we just need to decide it in a meeting?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, that must be it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A meeting it is! Let's decide on that position right away.」

name: Helena
message: 「Try coming up with something that fits both organizationally and position-wise.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A position... Archangel, Apprentice Angel... Mmm~」

name: Misa
message: 「In a normal company, it'd be Chairman, President, CEO, GM... No, no, in times like this... um, what was it again...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm... How about Advisor?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's great!」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, w-wait, everyone...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, I'd like to put the motion of appointing Ria-senpai as Student Council Advisor to a vote in this meeting.」

name: Synn
message: 「This is our glorious first Student Council meeting!」

name: Synn
message: 「Those in favor, please raise your hands.」

name: Everyone
message: 「In favor!」

name: Synn
message: 「Unanimously, this motion has been passed!」

name: Ria
message: 「Is this really... really okay...?」

name: Helena
message: 「You're going to test whether it's okay or not, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Test...?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right... What we decided here is just a provisional decision. To be officially adopted--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Those are the Student Council rules, after all. We have to ask everyone properly.」

name: Misa
message: 「But even if we ask them blindly, wouldn't they just fail to understand?」

name: Helena
message: 「That is why we establish a precedent beforehand--so to speak, adopting this matter as a trial, reporting the results, and taking a vote.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If this gets approved, then Senpai will get to stay with us next year, the year after that, and forever and ever, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Surely that's a bit...」

name: Helena
message: 「You never know, actually~ \s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san. May I try out this advisory role proposal?」

name: Helena
message: 「Why not? I'll give special permission under my authority as Board Chairman.」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Board Chairman can actually do something like that...」

name: Helena
message: 「Yep. I just decided it right now.」

name: Misa
message: 「A true abuse of power...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I can't tell at all if she's serious or joking.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sorry. My sister is just like this...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu. Student Council President, this favor is going to cost you big time~~」
Ugh, I dread what comes next.

name: Synn
message: 「But with this, Senpai is--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Officially one of us in the Student Council!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hooray!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone... thank you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank goodness... I'm so glad, Onee-sama...」

name: Helena
message: 「Congratulations on launching the new Student Council. Here's a gift to celebrate.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... what are we supposed to do with this trophy...」

name: Helena
message: 「Make sure to display it with care.」
Whoa, this is gonna be such a pain.

name: Helena
message: 「Good luck. I'm expecting great things from you, Ryuusei Crusaders!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ryuusei... Crusaders...?」

name: Helena
message: 「'Student Council' doesn't sound cool enough for beating up demons, right? That's why you're Crusaders.」
Oho, Crusaders. That actually sounds pretty cool.

name: Ria
message: 「Sis... Um, thanks.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Thank you very much!」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm counting on you, Crusaders!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, that was one hell of a detour.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean by that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Demon hunting, Student Council business, Helena the chairwoman... You even played up your own uselessness just to stay by Ria-chan's side.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Using whatever's at hand, even if it's poison--as expected of you, Lord Demon King.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--! You're the one who wants to be with Ria-senpai!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Are you sure about that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you flirting with a plushie?」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, please, just shut up for a second.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, yeah, as you wish.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Umm, anyway, now that Ria―senpai has joined us, this newly reborn Ryuusei Student Council has its work cut out for it. From here on out, what we need to do is―」

name: Misa
message: 「Planning and measures for Student Council duties and dealing with those 'demons.'」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, exactly. That's it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I kind of get the Student Council stuff, but these 'demons' still don't really click with me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai. In the end, what are we supposed to do?」

name: Ria
message: 「You don't call him by his title.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a bit hard to explain...」

name: Ria
message: 「First of all, thank you. I was really happy that everyone gave me such a warm welcome.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll do my absolute best as a member of the Student Council too. So if there's anything you don't understand, feel free to ask me anything.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes! What are Demons like?」

name: Synn
message: 「If I remember right, they were kinda round with little nubs, swole all over, with spinning eyes going ‘eeee-eee-eee’?」

name: Misa
message: 「What is that even supposed to mean? That explanation makes zero sense.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If I had my phone on me back then, I could've snapped a commemorative photo.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way. We definitely didn't have time for that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun only saw one for the first time yesterday, after all. It can't be helped.」

name: Ria
message: 「A~ll right then--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!? Senpai, what are you drawing!?」

name: Ria
message: 「A portrait of a Demon.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I see!」

name: Misa
message: 「As Student Council President, this is only natural for her.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Can you draw one, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Of course I can! ...Well, at least... something like Rakkuma...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm just the *Vice* President, so it's fine!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, something's wrong here. Did Misa just willingly accept being Vice President?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're pretty slow to notice.」
Ignoring our banter, Senpai's pen glides smoothly across the paper.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Drawing without a single moment of hesitation... that's amazing!」

name: Misa
message: 「As expected of Senpai... To think she had artistic talent, too...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Seriously. I could never!」

name: Synn
message: 「Couldn't you draw Soba and cake?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sweets, not cake! Besides, as if I'd ever draw Soba!!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you draw them so they look delicious, it'd be great promotion. We'd make a fortune!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Our shop competes on taste!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Excited*, I can't wait to see how it turns out!」

name: Ria
message: 「--There, all done.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Ooooh~~~」
Everyone peeks at the finished drawing.
Huh, wait? Was it really like this?
The shape is distorted, and something like a pitch-black sinister aura is squirming around it.
I can't even tell where the facial features are in the first place. The eyes and mouth that were so distinctive--where on earth are they?
Is my memory misremembering things? Or did Leah―senpai―
Ah, she has such a proud smile on her face. She's completely confident without a shred of doubt. Surely I must be the one who's wrong, yeah, that's it.

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, exactly like this! Did everyone get it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-Is this a demon...? It's my first time seeing one!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Vice President, did you get it?」

name: Misa
message: 「O... Of course! I grasped it clearly! Perfectly!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then I'll just pretend I got it too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, it looks sinister just by looking at it, doesn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... To think a guy like this was up to no good, I never knew until now.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wonder if he was doing pickpocketing, purse snatching, or robbery?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Flinch*!! I won't hand over Tontoro!」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai. But how are we supposed to fight this demon? Anyone who practices martial arts is--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sleeper hold locked in--!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah, guh, I can't breathe, I tap, I tap!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though they were doing trial memberships for the Tea Ceremony Club, Flower Arranging Club, Noodle Club, Shogi Club, and Maiden Club?」

name: Misa
message: 「Doesn't seem like they're here\s10」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, you see, we don't fight with physical strength. No, in fact, if we tried to rely on brute force, we wouldn't last a second.」

name: Lolotte
message: "Is that true!?

name: Lolotte
message: Eeeek!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn. How did a delicate guy like you beat that poltergeist?」

name: Synn
message: 「With this, right here.」

name: Misa
message: 「What about the Rosary?」

name: Synn
message: 「This Rosary lends me its power.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehh, whaaaaat!?」

name: Ria
message: 「You know this Rosary has been passed down through generations in the Student Council, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「But why it needed to be passed down--the answer is this demon extermination.」

name: Synn
message: 「So last year's Student Council members, and the ones before that, were all fighting demons too?」

name: Ria
message: 「That was originally the intent, but ever since the Great Meteor Shower 25 years ago, things never got so dire.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Great Meteor Shower?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shooting stars rain down all across the sky, making it look like a shower of stars.」

name: Misa
message: 「I've heard about what happened 25 years ago from my parents. They said it was so beautiful it was truly moving.」

name: Ria
message: 「In the Kujou family, the period when many shooting stars fall is called 'Re-Crea.'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Re-Crea...」

name: Ria
message: 「Re-Crea is abnormal weather, supernatural phenomena... an unsolved, mysterious natural phenomenon.」

name: Ria
message: 「Most people see Re―Crea as a tourist spectacle, but actually―」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena mentioned it, didn't she? That when lots of shooting stars fall, many demons appear.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. We don't really know the reason why, though...」

name: Misa
message: 「Because Senpai drove those demons away, it made it seem to ordinary people like nothing out of the ordinary was happening.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's true. I was born and raised in this town, but I didn't notice a thing.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's also true that nothing major enough to cause serious trouble happened since the previous Re-Crea. That's why my sister and I were able to manage on our own.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did Helena-san say something similar to you, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「My sister was a student here too―and just like Synn―kun and me, she was the Student Council President.」

name: Misa
message: 「But this year, you told us about Re-Crea, didn't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「The cycle of Re-Crea is usually six months at the shortest, and a few years at the longest. Only during Re-Crea has this Student Council borrowed the power of the Rosaries to fight Demons.」

name: Ria
message: 「Up until the previous Re―Crea, that was enough to get by. But―」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For twenty-five years, Re-Crea didn't come even once.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. So, if Re-Crea is coming this year...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Twenty-five years of buildup... That sounds like it could turn into something terrible...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's strange. It sounds a little different from the story I know...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's wrong, Lolo-chan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wah-wah! It's nothing!」

name: Ria
message: 「Just as Synn―kun said. We can't even imagine what kind of things might happen from here on out. That's why―」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why we need the power of the Rosaries--the power of the Guardian Angels, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Preparing for the worst is the secret mission hidden within this Student Council.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How wonderful! The power of the Angels who protect the world!」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait a moment! Why did you keep something so important a secret?!」

name: Ria
message: 「If everyone knew, it would cause a huge panic, wouldn't it?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, yes, but to think you've been doing something so dangerous all by yourself all this time, Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「These four Rosaries entrusted to the Student Council... Not just anyone can hold them.」

name: Ria
message: 「Our current age is when one is best suited to draw out the Angel's Spirit Power. As you grow older, that sensitivity gradually fades away.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Does it disappear as we grow up?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like a dream or something?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I will never accept such a thing!」

name: Ria
message: 「And to fight together, you need a certain level of aptitude and mutual trust.」

name: Ria
message: 「In other words, only chosen beings are permitted to wield the power of the Rosary.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-We were really that special...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Doesn't look like it to me at all, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's why disbandment is on the table... I feel like I'm starting to get it now.」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmh, then I get it too!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Basically, all we have to do is borrow the power of the Angels and give those mean old demons what for, right?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Exactly. Taking advantage of a crisis like this makes them no better than common looters. It's unforgivable.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hear, hear.」
If I confessed right now that I was the Demon King myself, being burned at the stake would probably be the least of my worries...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, just chasing off those demons won't actually solve anything, will it? I feel like we need to come up with a real root solution.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wow! Madam Treasurer is actually saying something sensible for once!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the last person I want to hear that from, Lolo!」

name: Ria
message: 「Well... you're right, but... the demon commotion is just the visible symptom, so who knows what's actually happening behind the scenes...」

name: Ria
message: 「If only 'that person' were here at a time like this...」
Was I the only one who heard that?
With eyes longing for someone's return, Ria-senpai quietly murmured in a faint, barely audible voice.
Her expression made it impossible for me to ask who 'that person' was, leaving me with a vague, unsettled feeling inside.

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's what the Student Council is for! Let's all do our best together!」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't need a lecture from you, Sakura-kun. But don't misunderstand. I'm only doing this for Senpai's sake.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm so excited! I want to hurry up and blast those bad guys away!!」
Yeah, I'm definitely starting to get worried again.

name: Nanaka
message: 「It'll be fine! Everything's gonna work out!」

name: Synn
message: 「I hope so...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Compared to losing a hundred yen, this isn't even a big deal!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, good point!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, I had no idea this Rosary was such a huge deal. I'm a little shocked.」
Nanaka fidgeted with the Rosary inquisitively, turning it over in her hands.

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Wait... what is this?! Strange words suddenly popped into my head...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, don't tell me--!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa! What is this?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amazing, amazing! You transformed!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Seriously, so awesome! I've gotta show this off!」

name: Misa
message: 「N-Nanaka-san... How immodest...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Zing!* *Swoosh!* *Sparkle sparkle!* A transformation! It's a real transformation?! That's the first time I've ever seen one!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thump-thump-thump-thump-thump-thump-thump-thump\s03」

name: Paqy
message: 「Get a grip, Demon Lord!」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, how could you say something like that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's fine. Everyone is totally dazed anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so? Thank goodness. Are you completely unfazed, Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, I couldn't care less.」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought I'd be the same, but I guess I was mistaken. Seeing it right in front of my eyes hit me with a huge shock.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You've seen your childhood friend naked before, haven't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if I look back, I don't have a single memory like that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Are you two really childhood friends?」
Only a faint trace in my memories. But since it was when we were little, I don't really remember.

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Forget what you just saw right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not even gonna ask IF I saw it?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course you saw it!! You're a boy, after all!!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, yeah, but...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Vice President, did you see that?! A transformation, a transformation!! Let's share in the excitement together!!」

name: Misa
message: 「A-Ah, hey!! I'm kind of busy right now!」
So the Rosary's power really can transform you after all.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Master Synn. Forget about the hysteric. More importantly, do something about Ria-chan!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「This must be a dream... a dream...」
Dazed, she squishes and pinches her own cheek.

name: Ria
message: 「Ouch, ch-ch-ch!」
Surprisingly playful.

name: Ria
message: 「No way... You're naked, Big Sis...」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you okay... Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, no, Synn-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you... not know?」

name: Ria
message: 「Because Big Sis told me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san... Right, Helena-san transformed too, didn't she? Seeing that should've made it obvious...」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, but when I told her, 'You're naked!', Big Sis said--」

name: Helena
message: 「That's just your imagination, Ria. It only looks like I'm naked.」

name: Helena
message: 「When you think of transformations, you think of being naked, right? I wanted to be naked. So I'm just making it look like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「To think it was a lie... And I believed her...」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you never question Helena-san 'wanting to be naked'?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, she's my big sister.」
Surprisingly persuasive words.

name: Synn
message: 「But why would she tell a lie like that?」

name: Helena
message: 「Because if she knew she had to get naked, she'd be too embarrassed, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「...Yeah, true.」

name: Helena
message: 「If she's embarrassed, she can't fight Demons properly. Thinking about Ria's safety, I had no choice but to do this.」

name: Ria
message: 「No way... Sis, you lied to me for my sake...?」

name: Synn
message: 「She's definitely playing you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Helena-san!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, yes, what is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Umm, when did you get back?」

name: Misa
message: 「Never mind the pointless small talk!! More importantly--」

name: Misa
message: 「I can't do something like this! In front of a boy... um, well...」

name: Helena
message: 「You don't want to get naked?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't say it so bluntly!!」

name: Helena
message: 「*Inhaaale*... *Pffuuuuh*. Young lady, is \{that|\s12\s12} you're wearing just for show?」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-What does the Rosary have to do with anything?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Tsk, tsk. Wrong. That badge is the pride of the NYPD... *Inhaaale*... *Pffuuuuh*.」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san. You don't have a cigar, you know.」

name: Helena
message: 「In this town, I am the law. Call me BOSS.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, Sis... imitating TV dramas again...」
Which show is she mimicking?

name: Misa
message: 「Anyway, I refuse to transform!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you saying, Vice President?! Doesn't that look super fun?!」

name: Misa
message: 「It is NOT fun!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After seeing something like that, doesn't it make you want to transform right away?!」

name: Misa
message: 「NO, IT DOES NOT!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, I shall also right away--」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen to what people are saying--!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why are you getting in my way?」

name: Misa
message: 「There's a boy here, so it's a no-no-no--!」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan. Why don't you wait outside?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not the point, it's just plain forbidden!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My, what a handful you are, Vice President」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't that line meant for you!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, you do need a reason to transform, after all...」

name: Synn
message: 「Which means, if we create a situation where you *have* to transform...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, nice one! Let's go search for a Demon right away! That's the only way if we want to transform quickly!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, it's not like I wanted to see you naked or anything like that--」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're digging your own grave」

name: Helena
message: 「Have a nice trip~\s04」
